> Was anyone able to figure it out ? - I am getting the same results.

The accuracy rate to 100% is my own mistake.Maybe this way can help you.
The label should be “train//dog" no ”dog“ in this code.
`
class CatsDogsDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, file_list, transform=None):
        self.file_list = file_list
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        self.filelength = len(self.file_list)
        return self.filelength

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_path = self.file_list[idx]
        img = Image.open(img_path)
        img_transformed = self.transform(img)

        label = img_path.split("/")[-1].split(".")[0]
        label = 1 if label == "train\\dog" else 0

        return img_transformed, label`
